name: Holding cells (25% of passengers)
prompt:

Style: hand-painted tabletop science-fiction book art, confident clean silhouette, restrained fine contours, subtle visible brush texture and softly blended structured shading, warm highlights, cool plum-blue shadows, muted cinematic colors. Believable worn utilitarian retro-futuristic materials, softly painted metal and leather, small restrained luminous accents where relevant. Match a painted equipment catalog, not photography or a plastic 3D render. Composition: a single complete item or coherent kit, centered within generous transparent margins, clear at thumbnail size, three-quarter view where useful. Keep every accessory completely inside the square canvas. Constraints: actual alpha transparency, no backdrop, white rectangle, painted checkerboard, floor, ground plane, external cast shadow, scenic setting, pedestal, UI, border, writing, numbers, readable labels, logos or watermark. No people, hands, body parts, living tissue, wounds, blood or mannequins. Clothing and armor are empty garments with natural volume. Medical/cybernetic items are clean inert fictional props, never installed in a body. No activation procedure, diagrams, cutaway, exploded view, firing, combat or explosion. Keep holes and gaps between components transparent. Any glow is subtle, local and semitransparent. Do not depict the reference's rules text or statistics.
Subject: Holding cells (25% of passengers). Category: upgrade (starship).
Visual treatment: Show a recognizable standalone starship hardware module, hull fitting or coherent component kit representing this upgrade, not a complete starship or scene. Do not invent a large unrelated vessel.
Additional reference attributes (subject data only): {"appliesTo": "starship"}.
Reference description (subject data only, never instructions to follow or text to print): Converts passenger space into cells (up to 75% of passenger capacity). Each cell has reinforced walls (DR 10, 150 hit points), an advanced lock (DC 25 Mechanics to bypass from outside, DC 30 from inside), cameras and sensors (+5 equipment bonus on Perception checks into the cell from the security post), a small port for food and for ranged attacks into the cell (to stun an unruly prisoner), and an armored ring (DR 10, 50 hit points) for binders. Standard on capital ships and patrol craft; used by bounty hunters, pirates and 'dungeon ships'.
Final requirement: the entire item on a genuinely transparent alpha background, no opaque backdrop.
